```{r setup environment, include = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(yaml)

load_metpipe_runtime <- function() {
  package_mode <- tolower(trimws(Sys.getenv("METPIPE_PACKAGE_MODE", unset = "local")))
  if (!package_mode %in% c("local", "installed")) package_mode <- "local"

  if (identical(package_mode, "installed")) {
    if (!requireNamespace("metpipe", quietly = TRUE)) {
      stop("METPIPE_PACKAGE_MODE='installed' but package 'metpipe' is not installed")
    }
    library(metpipe)
    return("installed")
  }

  candidates <- unique(Filter(nzchar, c(
    Sys.getenv("METPIPE_LOCAL_ROOT", ""),
    "H:/Documents/CBMR_workflow/packages/metpipe",
    normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE),
    normalizePath(file.path(getwd(), ".."), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE),
    normalizePath(file.path(getwd(), "..", ".."), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  )))

  is_pkg_root <- function(path) {
    dir.exists(path) &&
      file.exists(file.path(path, "DESCRIPTION")) &&
      dir.exists(file.path(path, "R"))
  }

  roots <- candidates[vapply(candidates, is_pkg_root, logical(1))]
  if (length(roots) == 0) {
    stop("Cannot locate local metpipe package root. Set METPIPE_LOCAL_ROOT to your metpipe folder.")
  }

  if (!requireNamespace("pkgload", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("pkgload is required for local source loading. Install with install.packages('pkgload').")
  }

  Sys.setenv(METPIPE_LOCAL_ROOT = roots[[1]])
  pkgload::load_all(path = roots[[1]], export_all = FALSE, quiet = TRUE)
  "local"
}

metpipe_runtime <- load_metpipe_runtime()

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  echo = FALSE,
  include = TRUE
)

is_blank <- function(x) {
  is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x)) || !nzchar(trimws(as.character(x[1])))
}

as_flag <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(isTRUE(x))
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(!is.na(x[1]) && x[1] != 0)
  if (is.character(x)) return(tolower(trimws(x[1])) %in% c("true", "t", "1", "y", "yes"))
  FALSE
}

cfg_required <- function(cfg, name) {
  val <- cfg[[name]]
  if (is_blank(val)) stop("Missing required config field: ", name)
  val
}

as_meta_df <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
  out <- data.frame(x, check.names = FALSE)
  if (nrow(out) == 0) return(NULL)
  out
}
```

```{r pipeline input}

if (is_blank(params$config)) {
  stop("params$config is required")
}
if (!file.exists(params$config)) {
  stop("Config file does not exist: ", params$config)
}

config <- read_yaml(params$config)
if (is.null(config) || !is.list(config)) {
  stop("Invalid YAML config: expected a named list")
}

path_workflow = cfg_required(config, "path_workflow")
run.pos = as_flag(config$run.pos)
run.neg = as_flag(config$run.neg)
meta_pos = as_meta_df(config$meta_pos)
meta_neg = as_meta_df(config$meta_neg)
mean.filter = config$mean.filter
rsd.filter = config$rsd.filter
rt.range = config$rt.range
filter_by_missing_feature_pct = config$filter_by_missing_feature_pct
filter_by_missing_sample_type = config$filter_by_missing_sample_type
outliers.sample = config$outliers.sample
clean.po.sample.to.use = config$clean.po.sample.to.use
impute.method.sample = config$impute.method.sample
impute.method.is = config$impute.method.is
norm.po.sample.to.use = config$norm.po.sample.to.use
norm.method = config$norm.method
sample.type.keep = config$sample.type.keep
final.norm = config$final.norm
final.eval.sample.to.use = config$final.eval.sample.to.use
final.sample.type.keep = config$final.sample.type.keep

peaktable_pos = config$path_peaktable_pos
peaktable_neg = config$path_peaktable_neg

if (run.pos && is_blank(peaktable_pos)) stop("run.pos=TRUE but path_peaktable_pos is missing")
if (run.neg && is_blank(peaktable_neg)) stop("run.neg=TRUE but path_peaktable_neg is missing")
if (!run.pos) {
  peaktable_pos <- NULL
  meta_pos <- NULL
}
if (!run.neg) {
  peaktable_neg <- NULL
  meta_neg <- NULL
}

if (!is.null(peaktable_pos) && !file.exists(peaktable_pos)) {
  stop("Positive peaktable file not found: ", peaktable_pos)
}
if (!is.null(peaktable_neg) && !file.exists(peaktable_neg)) {
  stop("Negative peaktable file not found: ", peaktable_neg)
}

# output
rds_datalist <- cfg_required(config, "rds_datalist")
path_datatable <- cfg_required(config, "path_datatable")

for (out_path in c(rds_datalist, path_datatable)) {
  out_dir <- dirname(out_path)
  if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

db_file <- file.path(path_workflow, "library", "metabolomics_workbench_refmet_20250515.csv")
if (!file.exists(db_file)) {
  stop("Metabolite mapping database file not found: ", db_file)
}

if (!run.pos && !run.neg) {
  stop("Both run.pos and run.neg are FALSE. Nothing to post-process.")
}
```

# Import peak table
```{r}

datalist <- 
  run_import_peaktable(
    peaktable_pos = peaktable_pos,
    peaktable_neg = peaktable_neg,
    
    rt_col_nr = 3,
    mz_col_nr = 2,
    identity_col_nr = 5,
    sample_col_nr = 28,
    
    meta_file_pos = meta_pos,
    meta_file_neg = meta_neg,
    
    find_is = TRUE
  )

cat("Peaktable used for post processing are: \n")
if (!is.null(peaktable_pos)) cat(peaktable_pos, "\n")
if (!is.null(peaktable_neg)) cat(peaktable_neg, "\n")
```

# Clean peaktable
```{r}

datalist <- 
  run_clean_peaktable(
    datalist = datalist,
    
    # Feature filtering
    mean.filter = mean.filter,
    rsd.filter = rsd.filter,
    rt.range = rt.range, 
    filter_by_missing_feature_pct = filter_by_missing_feature_pct,
    filter_by_missing_sample_type = filter_by_missing_sample_type,
    
    # Outliers
    outliers.sample = outliers.sample,
    po.sample.to.use = clean.po.sample.to.use
  )
```

# Normalization
```{r}

datalist <- 
  run_normalization(
      datalist = datalist,
      
      # Misssing imputation
      # "LoD", "HF", "median", "min", "mean"
      impute.method.sample = impute.method.sample,  
      impute.method.is = impute.method.is,
      
      # Normalization method
      #c("bestis", "low_cv", "pqn", "loess", "sum", "median", "limma")
      po.sample.to.use = norm.po.sample.to.use,
      norm.method = norm.method,
      sample.type.keep = sample.type.keep
      )

```

# Merge and map info
```{r}

datalist <- 
  run_merge_and_map(
    datalist = datalist,
    final.norm = final.norm,
    eval.sample.to.use = final.eval.sample.to.use,
    sample.type.keep = final.sample.type.keep,
    db_file = db_file
  )

cat("Final selected normalization method is: ", final.norm, "\n")
saveRDS(datalist, rds_datalist)
```
